title: Eloralintide, a selective amylin receptor agonist for the treatment of obesity: a 48-week phase 2, multicentre, double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled trial.
excerpts: Eloralintide is a novel, selective amylin receptor agonist in development for weight management.
This study was completed on Aug 14, 2025, and is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT06230523).
randomly assigned (2:1:1:1:2:1:2) to receive once-per-week subcutaneous injections of placebo or eloralintide at 1 mg, 3 mg, 6 mg, or 9 mg
a BMI of 27 kg/m2 or higher with at least one weight-related comorbidity and without type 2 diabetes
mean bodyweight 109·1 kg [22·8], BMI 39·1 kg/m2 [6·8], 204 [78%] female, and 205 [78%] White
The primary endpoint was percent change in bodyweight from baseline after 48 weeks of treatment.
compared with -0·4% (-2·2 to 1·4) in the placebo group
